Selected Food Sources of Vitamin B6—cont’d
*DV 5 Daily Value. DVs were developed by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration 
(FDA) to help consumers compare the nutrient contents of products within the context 
of a total diet. The DV for vitamin B6 is 2 mg for adults and children age 4 and older. 
However, the FDA does not require food labels to list vitamin B6 content unless a 
food has been fortified with this nutrient. Foods providing 20% or more of the DV are 
considered to be high sources of a nutrient.
